title: BIZ UDGothic
description: A universal-design Japanese gothic, drawn so similar glyphs are harder to misread. The usual tone for news, reporting, and information subtitles. The binaries (Regular and Bold) are already bundled at assets/font/biz-udgothic/ in this repo (added 2026-08-03. The catalog side stays an index, and source below is the fetch record).
when_to_use: Captions for news, reporting, and explainers. Scenes where readability comes first
ai_usage: ウェイトは用途に応じて選び分けてよい。字間・行間・カラーは overlay/テロップ側で調整してよいが、グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
